title: Selected etchings by Piranesi, series 1.

This book captures the essence of Piranesi's contributions to architecture through detailed etched plates, showcasing Roman ruins, ornamental designs, and various architectural concepts. It serves as a visual compendium of Piranesi's work that impacted European architecture. The accompanying introduction by C.H.
